one_line: 113 MB Scrapy project (pushed 8 Jul 2026, 0 stars, NO licence declared) for Viator, GetYourGuide, HIS, JTB and Veltra that — unlike the other Viator repos — commits its OUTPUT: supplier_activites/supplier_activites/output holds 'Suppliers Master File.csv' (4.94 MB) and a second 'Copy' of it, 'vietnam_iternaery_data.csv' (13.2 MB), output/gyg with Japan (7.96 MB), Spain (10.4 MB), Thailand (5.25 MB), Vietnam (7.98 MB) and United-Kingdom (10 KB) GYG Data .xlsx files, and output/viator with 'Pakistan Viator Data.xlsx' (13.9 KB) plus 'Scrapped data' and 'csv files' subfolders; input/ carries the seed URL lists (viator_input_urls.txt, gyg_input_urls.txt, his/jtb/veltra .xlsx).
abnb_use: A committed, country-level snapshot of tours-and-activities supply and list pricing for Japan, Spain, Thailand, Vietnam, UK and Pakistan — adjacent-supply and pricing read on the Experiences/Services competitive set (gap #9) and rare APAC/LatAm-adjacent coverage against gap #7; the supplier master file is also a ready-made operator universe for any Experiences TAM sanity check.
sample_plan: No scraper is run; pull only already-committed files, all via raw.githubusercontent. (1) curl -L -o gyg_uk.xlsx 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/usamaislam70/Viator-and-GYG-Scraper/HEAD/supplier_activites/supplier_activites/output/gyg/United-Kingdom%20GYG%20Data.xlsx' (10 KB); (2) curl -L -o viator_pakistan.xlsx 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/usamaislam70/Viator-and-GYG-Scraper/HEAD/supplier_activites/supplier_activites/output/viator/Pakistan%20Viator%20Data.xlsx' (14 KB); (3) head only of the big CSVs — curl -L -r 0-1500000 -o suppliers_master_head.csv '.../output/Suppliers%20Master%20File.csv' and curl -L -r 0-1000000 -o vietnam_itinerary_head.csv '.../output/vietnam_iternaery_data.csv'; (4) the two tiny seed lists .../input/viator_input_urls.txt and .../input/gyg_input_urls.txt. Do NOT fetch the Japan/Spain/Thailand/Vietnam GYG .xlsx files (5-10 MB each, xlsx cannot be range-read). Total well under 5 MB. Record column headers, row counts in the head, any date/price/review-count columns, and whether prices carry a currency.
